scope: Independent read-only review and CPU synthetic numerical checks of the working-copy projector; not a real-CAD coverage or training-quality evaluation.

version_boundary.audited_snapshot: Working copy before the final stored-FP32-UV residual recomputation fix; its exact file SHA was not captured.
version_boundary.later_fix_status: Parent and projection agent reported deployment and separate GPU synthetic/32-CAD validation. Those later checks are outside this independent audit.

surface_and_derivative_checks.chart: 16x16, cubic, clamped open-uniform knots, nonperiodic, sample grid [v,u], coordinates (u,v)
surface_and_derivative_checks.parameter_locations: Union of linspace(0,1,31) and all spline knots, including 0 and 1; paired UV uses the reversed second coordinate.

dynamic_programming_checks.reviewed_transition_axes: transition[current_candidate, previous_candidate]; forward includes the current unary cost and backward excludes it.

competitive_marginals.comparison: For each point and candidate, exhaustively minimize full-path cost subject to that candidate, then apply the same cost-margin, UV-separation and residual tests.

branch_semantics_checks.construction: Synthetic candidate UV/residual/Jacobian arrays supplied directly to path selection; these checks do not exercise multistart projection convergence on a real cylinder.

seam_line.description: Two equally accurate, equally continuous complete branches at u=0 and u=1, with v increasing along a noncollapsed line.

closed_circle.description: Unique interior progression from u=0 to u=1; endpoints each offer equivalent u=0/1 candidates. Neighboring positions resolve the endpoint ambiguity without forcing UV closure.

findings_forwarded_to_implementation_age.finding: Initial cache stored FP32 UV but retained the residual and residual mask computed before the FP64-to-FP32 coordinate conversion.
findings_forwarded_to_implementation_age.requested_change: Re-evaluate residual at the final stored UV and update the residual reason bit/valid mask.
findings_forwarded_to_implementation_age.status: Fix reported implemented and separately validated by the parent/projection agent; not independently retested here.

findings_forwarded_to_implementation_age.finding: Initial reason_flags validation allowed signed integer arrays and rejected values above 31, but did not reject negative values.
findings_forwarded_to_implementation_age.impact_boundary: Normal generator output used uint8, so this concerns malformed-cache validation rather than generated labels.
findings_forwarded_to_implementation_age.status: Reported to projection agent; this audit does not independently verify the final validator revision.

limitations: No exact SHA was captured for the working-copy snapshot under audit; do not attribute these measurements to the later repaired SHA.
No real-CAD projection, full-cache coverage, timing, GPU numerical behavior, or downstream training improvement was measured by this auditor.
DP and seam checks validate candidate selection and ambiguity handling, not completeness of the nonlinear multistart candidate search.
No source or implementation files were edited during the read-only audit; this JSON is its subsequent record.
